title: The residual compact quotient is proper and stratified by charge support

residual_strata.group: The residual constant compact circle U(1) leaves the Coulomb connection fixed and acts on matter charge q by multiplication with exp(i theta q)
residual_strata.support_stabilizer: For nonzero occupied integer charges S, the stabilizer is {exp(i theta): exp(i theta q)=1 for every q in S}; it is the finite cyclic group determined by gcd(|q|:q in S)
residual_strata.neutral_stabilizer: If the matter data have support only in ker Q, the full residual U(1) stabilizes them
residual_strata.free_stratum: Charge support with gcd one has trivial residual stabilizer
residual_strata.properness: Compactness makes the residual action proper on every completed triangular tier; the orbit space is Hausdorff and the orbit map is closed
residual_strata.stratification: Changing occupied charge support can change the stabilizer, so the full quotient is a proper orbit-type stratified space rather than one globally free Hilbert manifold
residual_strata.energy: The positive gauge-invariant Hamiltonian is constant on residual orbits and descends continuously to every stratum
residual_strata.boundary: Proper stratification is classical quotient geometry. It neither selects the physical charge normalization nor constructs a Hilbert-space representation of observables
